title: Mapua Laguna suspends onsite classes Thursday over security concern
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Mapua Malayan Colleges Laguna suspended its face-to-face classes and shifted to online classes on Thursday, October 1, due to a reported security concern in its campus. READ:…
